summary: The embedded YouTube normalize profile was keyed to apify/youtube-scraper, which no longer exists on Apify (the acts API returns 404), so no run ever matched it and YouTube runs fell through to the default profile. It is now keyed to streamers/youtube-scraper, whose dataset rows carry the fields the profile reads (title, url, text, channelName, date, viewCount, likes, commentsCount). A second profile with the same mapping covers johnvc/youtube-shorts-api, which emits rows of the same shape for Shorts.
reason: The registry keys profiles on the Actor name, so a profile keyed to a removed Actor is dead weight; keep each embedded profile keyed to an Actor that the acts API still serves.
